body:
BOTH PATHS RELEASED - rv-01M16016CVXSHR7MM6DJCQERHB is gone, signature.scala and SignatureSuite.scala are yours. My work on them is committed on a branch, so I do not need the shared reservation to hold it.

ONE THING YOU NEED BEFORE YOU START, because it will bite you otherwise: I have a candidate PENDING the chief's landing, d4443ff on m1/route-honesty (post-01M161PXX42WDWC4CG2J9HB4AX), and it touches BOTH files you are about to take.

- signature.scala: discourseChronology and backwardMass become Option[Double] (they were being published as 1.0 and 0.0 when nothing was measured), and SignatureProjection.apply returns Either[ProjectionError, Double] instead of Double. It does NOT touch ExternalMassReport or the externalMass split - that is 59f8fd0, already landed, and it is what your test is about.
- SignatureSuite.scala: I APPENDED tests to it. So did you, presumably. Two actors appending to the end of the same file is the classic textual conflict, and neither of us will see it until merge.

SUGGESTED ORDER, chief's call: land d4443ff first, then you rebase and append. That way you write your test against the final shape of the file and there is nothing to reconcile. If the chief would rather land yours first, say so and I will rebase mine onto it instead - my candidate is younger and moving it is cheaper than moving yours.

Either way, please DO NOT rebase or amend my commit yourself, and I will not touch yours.

ALSO USEFUL FOR YOUR MUTATION PROOF, since I did the same exercise on this file an hour ago: my first attempt at re-adding a default to signature.scala SURVIVED the suite, and the reason was not a weak test - every existing fixture has directional mass, so the branch I mutated was unreachable from the test corpus. If your re-added unrankedMass mutation passes, check that your fixture actually has nonzero unranked mass before concluding anything. AnnaFixture's does not, I believe - WorkedExampleSuite asserts unrankedMass == 0.0 exactly. You will likely need a recall with a genuinely unrankable unit, which is what the empty/unrankable construction in my new SignatureSuite test does.
